notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl impersonating Chrome UA) succeeded for robots.txt, homepage HTML (mega-menu), Shopify /collections.json, and /collections/<handle>/products.json for every candidate node - no block, so Playwright/CDP and Claude-in-Chrome were not needed. robots.txt (Shopify default) is fully permissive (Allow: / for User-agent: *) with only private/transactional paths disallowed, so no access restriction applied to this fetch. TREE: built from the union of (1) the homepage mega-menu, read from the raw HTML header section - the relevant Decoration-menu columns are 'Linge de maison & tapis' (children: Coussins, Tapis, Linge de lit) and 'Linge de table' (children: Sets de table & Dessous de verre, Nappes), plus 'Rangements decoratifs' (children: Vide-poches, Petits rangements, Paniers & boites, Porte-manteaux & pateres); and (2) sitemap_collections_1.xml cross-check, which surfaced additional collections (textile, linge-de-bain, linge-de-maison, linge-accessoires-de-bain, linge-de-bain-enfants, plus the *-green variants) that are NOT linked anywhere in the mega-menu, the homepage footer, or the linge-de-maison-tapis page's own content (verified by grepping the fetched HTML for each handle - zero matches). These were excluded as unreachable via any real site-navigation path (textile.md/storage.md both require following the actual website navigation; the site is otherwise fully crawlable per robots.txt, so this is a genuine orphaned-collection finding, not an access block). No category page exposed an additional sub-nav strip beyond the mega-menu itself (checked by diffing in-page /collections/ links against header+footer links - identical set). QTY: exact counts obtained by paginating https://www.fleux.com/collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 to exhaustion and counting returned product entries - this is the same data the storefront grid itself renders, not the cached collection object. Cross-checked against the cached /collections.json 'products_count' field for 'coussins': cache said 163 vs 114 actual via pagination, confirming the prior finding that Shopify's products_count field is inflated/unreliable, so the paginated count was used throughout. EXCLUDED (checked and rejected): vide-poches (34-51 products, product_type breakdown 100% Plateau/Vide-poche/Porte-bagues i.e. decorative catch-all trays and ring dishes - storage.md explicitly lists 'Decorative Tray -> NOT Storage'); porte-manteaux-pateres (7 products, 100% Porte-manteau/Accroche murale i.e. coat racks and wall hooks - not a storage container/organizer under any storage.md subsection); rangements-decoratifs itself carries no own qty/link because valid Storage subcategories exist under it (parent-category-URL rule) and its own product mix is majority decorative trays/catch-alls (50/96) so it is used only as the grouping-row label; objets-de-decoration, vases, bougies-bougeoirs-allumettes, sculptures-figurines, box-surprise, pots-jardinieres, accessoires-design, decoration-murale (+ miroirs, affiches-tableaux, horloges, art-mural) - Decorative Home Accessories / Wall Decor, out of scope for this task; the entire Mobilier menu including meubles-de-rangement and etageres - the site places this under its Furniture nav section, so per storage.md rule 21 it stays Furniture, not Storage; the entire Luminaire menu - Lighting; Table & Cuisine tableware/cookware nodes (vaisselle, assiettes, carafes-verres, tasses-mugs, bols-coupelles, accessoires-de-table, plats, bouteilles-lunch-box, ustensiles-de-cuisine, epicerie) - Kitchen & Dining, out of scope; Lifestyle and most of Kids (toys, apparel, beauty, jewelry, bags) - fashion/general-merchandise, excluded per textile.md rules 18-19; the GREEN section (luminaire-green, decoration-green, textile-green, mobilier-green, rangements-green, etc.) - a promotional eco-themed re-filter of existing categories, treated like the sibling New/Must Have/sale collections and excluded as a non-navigational duplicate. INCLUDED WITH CAVEAT: sets-de-table-dessous-de-verre (Placemats & Coasters) kept in Textile even though the collection mixes product types, because its product_type breakdown is 34/47 (72%) 'Set de table' (fabric placemats, explicitly listed in textile.md #7) vs a minority of coasters/trivets/tableware; no separate placemat-only URL exists on the site, confidence MEDIUM. linge-accessoires (Kids Linen & Accessories, standalone leaf under the Kids menu column, no further site-defined parent to nest under) kept in Textile because its product_type breakdown is 24/29 (83%) Serviette/Couverture/Tapis/Cape de bain (towels, blankets, bath mat, bath cape/robe - genuine bathroom/bedroom textiles per textile.md #9/#20) vs a minority of Bavoir-typed items; confidence MEDIUM.
